content.short: Ton.place is a SocialFi platform on TON that allows content creators to monetize their work through subscriptions.
content.description: Ton.place is a premier decentralized social network built on the TON blockchain, designed to empower content creators with direct monetization tools. Similar to platforms like Patreon, it allows creators to offer exclusive content, host private chats, and receive tips from their audience in Toncoin. By removing intermediaries and leveraging the transparency of the blockchain, Ton.place ensures that creators retain a larger share of their earnings while providing fans with a secure and engaging social experience directly within the Telegram ecosystem.
content.meta: Monetize your content on Ton.place, the TON-based social network. Exclusive content and tips on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
